register.title: Create an account
register.privacyAccept: I have read how my data is processed
register.privacyClause: Your data is controlled by {administrator}, contact: {contact}. We process your email address, password (as a hash) and role to create and run your Spot On Slot account (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). Unconfirmed accounts are deleted after 7 days; others are kept until the account is deleted. You have the right to access, correct and delete your data and to lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority (in Poland, the President of UODO).
